headline: Wed done: 105 of 115. Run came up short and felt poor, spin delivered. Thu stays as planned.
summary: Readiness this morning was GREEN: HRV 60 (down 9 from 69, under the 10-point amber trigger), RHR 48, sleep 6.1h. Grade vs prescription: the AM run was 50 min / 9.9 km at 152 bpm avg against 72 min planned (60 min at 142-152 + 6x20s strides), so the run fell 22 min short. Load was 51 against ~60-80. Avg HR sat at the very top of the band. Max HR 183 fits strides, but I can't confirm the reps from this data. RPE 6 and feel 4 (Poor) on an easy run is the red note today. The PM spin was 50/50 min at 146 bpm avg, inside the 134-147 Z2 band (max 161), load 54, RPE 3, feel 3: done as written. Day total 105 vs 115. Week to date 190 vs 220 planned (Tue 85/105, Wed 105/115). CTL 55.2, ATL 68.0, TSB -12.8, so you're carrying the fatigue the last load week is meant to carry. No plan change: a -10 shortfall is small, and race-morning TSB was projected tight at +1.6, so it lands as a bit of freshness. Thu 29 (2x20 min at 160-166 + 45 min spin) is gated on tomorrow morning's numbers and its own stop rules.
flags: Easy volume under-delivered again: 50 of 72 min, avg 152 at the top of the 142-152 band. Same pattern as Fri 23 (155 avg) and Sun 25 (77 min in Z3-Z4).
Feel 4 (Poor) and RPE 6 on an easy run, the day after 8x4min. If tomorrow shows HRV under 55, a drop over 10, RHR 52+ or sleep under 5.5h, Thu goes amber: 2x15 min and spin 30 min.
Spin max 161 went into bike Z3 (148-157+). Keep spins under 147 on Thu.
